title: Esc key only closes the panel configurator, while its bottom-right-most button sometimes only closes it and sometimes also exits edit mode
line: Pressing Esc in Panel Settings now does the same as its Close / Exit Edit Mode button, so it also leaves edit mode when you opened Panel Settings directly.
explanation: PanelConfigView::keyPressEvent only hid the dialog on Esc, while the bottom-right button triggers the containment's 'configure' action (PanelView::showConfigurationInterface), which hides it and also leaves edit mode unless edit mode was entered from the desktop. In addition, choosing 'Exit Edit Mode' from the desktop menu set DesktopView's 'entered from desktop' flag after edit mode had already been turned off, leaving it stale so a later direct Panel Settings session kept edit mode on close. Esc now triggers the same 'configure' action (falling back to hide()), and the flag is set before edit mode is toggled.

commits.message:
shell: make Esc in Panel Settings do what its button does

Esc only hid Panel Settings, while its button also leaves edit mode when
it was entered just for the panel. Make Esc trigger the same action, and
reset the flag picking the button when leaving edit mode from the menu.

BUG: 522199

media.caption: Pure master: Panel Settings opened directly from the panel menu; its button reads Exit Edit Mode
Pure master: after pressing Esc, Panel Settings is gone but the desktop is still in edit mode
With the fix: same Panel Settings opened directly, button reads Exit Edit Mode
With the fix: after pressing Esc, edit mode is left too, like the button

review.text: Esc now triggers the same containment 'configure' action as the button, which is the simplest way to keep the two in sync, with hide() as fallback. Reordering the connections so m_enteredEditMode is set before edit mode toggles fixes the stale flag properly. Verification covers both edit-mode entry paths.
